import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('plugin installation finishes', function () {
  this.result = {
    exitCode: process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1' ? 1 : 0,
    ok: process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT !== '1',
    effects: ['installed safeword'],
    recovery: ['/reload-plugins'],
  };
});
Then('installation succeeds and reload guidance is shown', function () {
  assert.equal(this.result.effects.includes('installed safeword'), true);
  assert.match(this.result.recovery.join('\n'), /reload-plugins/);
});
